content: The concluding computation of the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk (per MK's translation): R = 200 and Kh = 600, sum 800, so the name Shāh Rukh means 'shah of 800', that is the sovereign of the century called samān-miʾa (800), and the royal name shows the state will last to the end of the current century, God willing. The treatise ties this to the divine name al-Ẓāhir (the Manifest), and says the hope of the 9th century bloomed on the day of the king's emergence.
refers_to_primary: R. Suʾl al-Mulūk, MS Majlis 10196 f. 178a-b; MS Majlis 10004 pp. 200-203
